description: Main server code for processing and injecting examples into OpenAPI specifications, including functions for parsing, rendering, and applying code examples based on API operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that reads an OpenAPI spec file, parses it, applies code examples, and writes back the updated spec.

methods.name: applyExamples
methods.description: Applies code examples to each API operation in the OpenAPI model by generating code snippets based on templates.

methods.name: applyExample
methods.description: Finds and injects code examples for specific API operations based on operation ID.

methods.name: getModelFuncs
methods.description: Parses Go source files in a directory to extract function declarations for generating code examples.
